title: Kura skill registry
description: Optional metadata for the catalog at ~/.config/kura/catalog. Skills are discovered from skills/<name>/SKILL.md; this file adds groups, dependencies, global policy and upstream sources on top of them. An entry named here whose source directory is absent stays representable so `kura list` and `kura doctor` can report it as missing.

$schema.description: URL or relative path of this schema.

version.description: Registry format version. Kura does not read it; existing registries carry 2.

repos.description: Upstream repositories, keyed by GitHub owner/repo. Only skills listed here are targets for `kura update` and `kura outdated`.

local_skills.description: Skills authored in the catalog itself. They have no upstream, so `kura update` leaves them alone.

upstream_path.description: Path of the skill inside the fetched repository. Empty, "." or "/" means the repository root is itself the skill. Its last component names the skill unless `name` overrides it.

skillName.description: One safe path component. It must equal the directory name under the catalog's skills/ and the `name` in that skill's SKILL.md frontmatter; a mismatch blocks installation.

groups.description: Opaque tags, matched exactly and never normalised. `global` is durable global policy: the skill and its dependencies are linked into every globally enabled harness by `kura sync`.

dependencies.description: Skill names pulled in recursively whenever this skill is installed. Dependencies are never written to a project's kura.json.

dependencyOnly.description: The skill installs only as another skill's dependency and refuses `kura add` by name.

updatedAt.description: When `kura update` last replaced the skill's content. Written as %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ.
